subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should GitHub-backed publisher display manifests become paginated, return only bounded source metadata, or remain complete responses under an explicit size limit?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the remaining unbounded read, but choosing the permanent response and UI contract changes product behavior and cannot be inferred safely from the partial optimization.

options.title: Use bounded metadata
options.body: Return only GitHub-source display metadata and load individual resources through the existing indexed catalog pagination path.

options.title: Paginate manifests
options.body: Introduce a bounded manifest cursor and update consumers to compose GitHub-backed catalogs incrementally.

options.title: Limit complete responses
options.body: Retain the complete manifest contract but enforce a documented maximum catalog size and operational monitoring.

recommendation.title: Use bounded metadata
recommendation.body: Return only GitHub-source display metadata and load individual resources through the existing indexed catalog pagination path.

likelyOwner.reason: They defined the completion boundary and implemented the preceding publisher-read changes.
